sources.title: distilbert/distilgpt2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Description: DistilGPT2 is an English-language model pre-trained with the supervision of the 124 million parameter version of GPT-2. DistilGPT2, which has 82 million parameters, was developed using knowledge distillation and was designed to be a faster, lighter version of GPT-2.

sources.title: DistilBERT-AI-Text-Detector
sources.snippet: The DistilBERT AI Text Detector is an experimental binary text classification model built by fine-tuning distilbert-base-uncased to distinguish between AI-generated and human-written text. Designed for sequence classification, it maps the output label 0 to human-written text and label 1 to AI-generated text.
